title: Radioactive decay tracks seen coming off tall white suits

tellings.quote: So when I saw those coming off their the suits of the tall whites out in the desert, I knew perfectly well what they were.

plain: Charles Hall, a man who says he spent three years in the mid-1960s near Area 51 in Nevada's Indian Springs Valley alongside tall, pale beings he calls the tall whites, says he saw radioactive decay tracks coming off their suits out in the desert. He tells Michels that he "knew perfectly well what they were," speaking as the person who saw them. If true, it would mean the beings' suits gave off radiation.
